eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 10:34 PM on AUG 30, 2024 Effective until 8:34 AM AUG 31, 2024. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for the Mesa Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Mesa Police Department is looking for 94-year-old, white male, named Elton Knowles. He was last seen driving in a Black Chevrolet Avalanche truck with Arizona Veterans License Plate 8 7 1 4 S, in the area of South Sossaman Road and East Broadway Road in Mesa, Arizona. Elton is 5 feet 11 inches tall and weighs 185 pounds, with White hair and Blue Eyes. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
